name: goo-account-router
description: Browser extension: opens each Google service in your chosen default account.

scripts.sign:firefox: BUILD_CHANNEL=self npm run build:firefox && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted --artifacts-dir dist/signed
scripts.deploy:site: node scripts/build-site.mjs && cd firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting --project goo-account-router
